annotations.title: Case law per article of an act

description: WHERE the case law of an act is: each article with the number of decisions linked to it, and how many of them are RIL/HP, by division, the numbers of the app's table of contents. Use it to see which articles carry much case law, which carry binding practice and which none, before reading an article or a list. A large act is shown by divisions; `part` opens one.

include_empty.description: true: also list the articles with no decision linked (default: only those with decisions).

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 85/2014', 'HG 1/2016'), a common name ('Codul muncii', 'CPC'), or a title any tool printed. An act that approves a code ('Legea 134/2010') is read as the code.

part.description: Optional. One division to open, e.g. 'Titlul VII' or 'Capitolul II'. Matched against the division names, diacritic-insensitively, as in get_act_structure.

name: get_act_case_law_map
